description: [ICLR-2026 main track] ProofBridge is a unified framework that translates natural language theorems and proofs into Lean 4 using joint embeddings, cross-modal retrieval-augmented fine-tuning, and iterative proof repair, achieving strong semantic and type correctness gains.
